reason: H0 fuzzes only the binary, JSON, and XML parsers through plist_from_bin, plist_from_json, and plist_from_xml. S1 adds a distinct OpenStep parser and serializer, plus OpenStep-aware dispatch in plist_from_memory, none of which H0 invokes. The new parser processes nested dictionaries and arrays, quoted and unquoted strings, escape sequences, comments, hexadecimal data, delimiters, and truncated buffers, making it a material fuzz-worthy input surface. The revised format-detection protocol in plist_from_memory is also uncovered by direct-format harnesses.
evidence: fuzz/bplist_fuzzer.cc calls only plist_from_bin and plist_free.
fuzz/jplist_fuzzer.cc calls only plist_from_json and plist_free.
fuzz/xplist_fuzzer.cc calls only plist_from_xml and plist_free.
include/plist/plist.h adds public entry points plist_from_openstep and plist_to_openstep.
plist_from_openstep passes attacker-controlled plist_ostep and length into node_from_openstep.
node_from_openstep contains separate parsing paths for '{', '(', '<', quoted strings, escape sequences, and unquoted strings; parse_skip_ws also parses '//' and '/*...*/' comments.
plist_from_memory now selects plist_from_openstep when input is not detected as binary, XML, or JSON, including '(' inputs and ambiguous '{' inputs.
plist_to_openstep recursively invokes node_estimate_size and node_to_openstep and varies output behavior with prettify, but H0 performs no OpenStep serialization or round-trip.
recommended_action: Add a dedicated libFuzzer target that feeds arbitrary byte buffers and explicit lengths to plist_from_openstep, frees any result, and exercises successful parses through plist_to_openstep with both prettify values. Also fuzz plist_from_memory separately so mutations cover binary/XML/JSON/OpenStep format-dispatch boundaries and ambiguous or truncated prefixes.
